programme_facts.value: The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance is the centre of academic and performance excellence at University of Limerick, Ireland. It honours the energies of performance and academic reflection across a wide range of genres and disciplines. These are informed by community outreach and artist-in-residence initiatives that take the Academy to the wider community, attracting international performance and scholarly expertise.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Partner Staff Weeks + Eligible duration and activities

programme_facts.value: The receiving institution must be a university with a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement with the University of Limerick.
Applicants must check with UL Global to ensure the institution has a valid mobility agreement.
Minimum duration of staff mobility is 2 days (excluding travel) and a maximum of 7 days (including travel).
Minimum of 8 teaching hours per week must be fulfilled during mobility.
